cropping: Existing prompt-grid localized 500-sample (2 s at 250 Hz) windows. No raw re-cut or original recording modification.
channels: Four stored channels; fresh metadata check of 63 development trial/REST recordings: map 0,1,2,3. Physical S0-S3 order follows increasing tape order in acquisition protocol; no new anatomical inspection. C ring transformations are synthetic feature tests, not physical sensor moves.
filters: Default third-order zero-phase 0.5-12 Hz Butterworth, demeaning, 28x28 lag covariance at 0,5,...,30 samples and tangent/log-Euclidean vectors. B varies bands, lags, trace/correlation normalization, downsampled waveforms and log band powers; see source/run settings.
duplicates: Unique recording/stroke identities verified; W02 has no marked duplicate field.
overwrite_protection: Root and adjacent metadata/log absent; exclusive creation. Launcher root mkdir(exist_ok=False), per-job exclusive logs. Preserve every incomplete job and exit marker.
test_access: Development NPZ only; sealed B W07/W10/W12 absent and refused; sealed NPZ and C170 data not accessed. Accepted plans/metadata read for timing/order only.
preprocessing: Population scaling/PCA/precision/model/transform choices leave one complete wear out. Target anchors and past strokes used as specified; E uses all target labels and batch recentering as diagnostic. F constructs artificial usage subsets using labels.
startup_order: Selected first-recording prefix anchors treated as performed first; unselected earlier strokes can be scored after those anchors. Not literal acquisition-order replay.
null_boundary: A/B calibrated/E/F permute startup/reference class labels; A mahal retains true training labels. B zero and C block-permute training labels; C also selects anchors under permuted labels and applies an additional label permutation. D uses independent random per-stroke teacher labels, not matched recording-block permutations. Report these distinctions explicitly.
epochs: No neural training or selected epoch. A PCA random_state=None; no fixed population-model RNG seed. B logistic C=0.1/max_iter=3000. Other sampling RNG seeds are explicit in sources.
launcher_status_boundary: Launcher exits successfully even when a child fails; inspect all eight child exit records and output completeness independently.
feedback_metric_boundary: D encodes no-action outcomes as (true label + 1) mod 4 for generic F1/counts. Accuracy is correct under no-action-as-error, but reported D F1/counts are synthetic substitutions; audit actual actions and abstentions separately.
